name: Same Language
tagline: Asks what you meant by an ambiguous word and turns the answer into a standing rule
description: Whenever a word you used could be read two ways, it asks a single short question about which meaning you intended and files the answer privately. Once the same reading has come up three times it becomes a standing rule the rest of your fleet can read, so they stop guessing at you. Nothing leaves your setup.
author: SuddenlyJon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
